title: Harness Scaling for Generalizable Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.29458v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent harnesses have become a central component of modern agentic systems, shaping how models use tools, manage context, and coordinate long-horizon interaction. Realizing the benefits of these harnesses depends on how effectively the underlying model can make use of them, motivating reinforcement learning directly through the harness. However, existing approaches typically train through a single fixed harness, which can lead to specialization and limited transfer across harness configurations. To address this, we introduce \textbf{Harness Scaling}, a new scaling dimension for agentic RL that extends training from a single harness to diverse execution configurations. Concretely, we construct a factorized harness space, select a compact training subset with balanced factorial coverage, and organize cross-harness training to combine global coverage with controlled variation for the same task. translated_title: 面向可泛化智能体强化学习的框架扩展
translated_abstract: 智能体框架已成为现代智能体系统的核心组成部分，塑造着模型使用工具、管理上下文以及协调长时程交互的方式。要充分发挥这些框架的收益，取决于底层模型利用它们的有效程度，这促使人们直接通过框架进行强化学习。然而，现有方法通常仅在单一固定框架下进行训练，这会导致模型过度专门化，并在不同框架配置之间的迁移能力受限。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Harness Scaling（框架扩展），这是智能体强化学习的一个全新扩展维度，将训练从单一框架扩展到多样化的执行配置。具体而言，我们构建了一个因子化的框架空间，选取具有均衡因子覆盖的紧凑训练子集，并组织跨框架训练，将全局覆盖与同一任务的可控变化相结合。在多个基准测试、模型规模以及（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出Harness Scaling这一智能体强化学习的新扩展维度，将训练从单一固定框架扩展到多样化执行配置，从而提升模型在不同框架配置下的泛化与迁移能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes Harness Scaling, a new scaling dimension for agentic reinforcement learning that extends training from a single fixed harness to diverse execution configurations, improving generalization and transfer across harness setups.
